resources.string: Allows viewing recordings from earlier installations. New videos can be recorded without this permission.
Shows recording and storage status while the app is in the background.
Required only for the optional coordinates stamp. Speed comes from the vehicle.
Additional access for older recordings. New recordings are cleaned up automatically; Android may separately ask to delete older media.
Needed for the floating recording button and camera window. Recording itself does not require it.
Android blocked deletion from the older archive. Check “Files from earlier installations” in Permissions above. Older media may require separate Android approval.
Select at least one recording camera.
The vehicle camera service is currently managed by another installation.
Vehicle cameras are unavailable on this device. You can try the interface without recording.
